boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along the University Boulevard corridor linking UA’s campus edge and downtown Tuscaloosa.

cards.title: Strange Brew Coffeehouse
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor — The Strip
cards.notes: Pause at the 1101 University Boulevard storefront for a coffee stop while following the campus-adjacent Strip corridor.
cards.short_summary: A coffeehouse at the campus-facing end of University Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Tuscaloosa lists Strange Brew Coffeehouse at 1101 University Blvd., Tuscaloosa.
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages are sold; confirm current business hours before visiting.

cards.title: The Standard
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor — The Strip
cards.notes: Use the 1217 University Boulevard address as a concrete waypoint when walking west from the university toward downtown.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant stop on the Strip section of the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Tuscaloosa lists The Standard at 1217 University Blvd., Tuscaloosa.
cards.access_notes: Food is sold; check the business directly for current hours and service details.

cards.title: Thai Basil Sushi
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor — The Strip
cards.notes: Find this 1402 University Boulevard restaurant while tracing the Strip’s commercial frontage across from campus.
cards.short_summary: A Thai-and-sushi restaurant on the Strip.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Tuscaloosa identifies Thai Basil Sushi at 1402 University Blvd. and describes Thai food and sushi service.
cards.access_notes: Food is sold; confirm current hours and menu options with the business.

cards.title: Ajian Sushi
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor — downtown approach

cards.short_summary: A restaurant waypoint between the Strip and downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Tuscaloosa lists Ajian Sushi at 1914 University Blvd., Tuscaloosa.
cards.access_notes: Food is sold; check the business directly for current hours and service details.

cards.title: Moe’s Original BBQ

cards.evidence_claim: Visit Tuscaloosa lists Moe’s Original BBQ at 2101 University Blvd., Tuscaloosa.
cards.access_notes: Food is sold; check the business directly for current hours and service details.

cards.evidence_claim: Visit Tuscaloosa lists Taco Mama at 2104 University Blvd., Tuscaloosa.

cards.evidence_claim: Visit Tuscaloosa lists Comfort Grounds Coffee Shop at 2218 University Blvd., Suite B, Tuscaloosa.
